verdict.rationale: Make's webhook docs say a webhook URL can be called 'from another' scenario to trigger its execution. That is a first-party documented way for one workflow to invoke another, but only a thin, truncated mention. There is no evidence of a dedicated sub-scenario or module-reuse feature, input/output contracts, or returning results to the caller. Data stores and cloning are adjacent and not credited. Missing for 10: a dedicated callable sub-scenario feature, documented input/output parameters and response return to the caller, versioned reusable modules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compose reusable sub-workflows or modules that other workflows call

citations.quote: webhooks create a url that you can call from an external app or service, or from another use webhooks to trigger the execution
